Holiday Closings

The Undergraduate Package Center and Administrative Mail Office are closed in observance of the following University holidays:

  • New Year's Day
  • Martin Luther King, Jr. Day
  • Memorial Day
  • Juneteenth
  • Independence Day
  • Labor Day
  • Election Day
  • Thanksgiving Day
  • The day after Thanksgiving
  • Christmas Eve
  • Christmas Day
  • New Year's Eve
